component.name: DropdownMenu
component.description: A floating list of actions or options anchored to a trigger, used inside AppHeader's user menu and Select.

useWhen: Displaying a list of selectable items anchored to a trigger element

notFor.case: Using DropdownMenu for navigation with URLs
notFor.because: Items are <div role='menuitem'>, not anchors. Navigation links need <a> elements for correct semantics.
notFor.note: Use a nav element with anchor links for navigation.

useWhen.menu: A contextual action menu, such as the AppHeader user menu. Items get role=menuitem.
useWhen.listbox: The options list of a custom Select. Items get role=option with aria-selected.

donts.case: Rendering DropdownMenu outside a position:relative container
donts.because: The panel is absolutely positioned and will be offset incorrectly without a positioned ancestor.
donts.instead: Always wrap the trigger and DropdownMenu in a position:relative container.
